title: Smart Curtain Timer Rules Failing After Power Outage
description: Smart curtain timer rules do not execute after a power outage. Manual and App controls work, but morning auto-open fails. Requires backend diagnosis, physical sync button press, and backend rule resend.

messages.label: User
messages.text: My smart curtains open and close fine when I use the app or pull them manually, but the morning automatic open timer hasn't worked since the power outage yesterday.

messages.label: check_device_logs
refresh_time_zone
Agent
messages.text: Please press the sync button on your smart curtain device to enter sync mode, then I will retry the time zone refresh.

messages.label: press_sync_button
User
messages.text: Okay, I've pressed the button.

messages.label: refresh_time_zone
resend_timer_rules
Agent
messages.text: The morning automatic open timer has been restored. Your smart curtains should now operate on schedule.

messages.label: User
messages.text: Oh, great! So it should work tomorrow morning then? Thank you for your help.

messages.label: Agent
messages.text: You're welcome! The timer is now active and should work as expected tomorrow morning.

messages.label: User
messages.text: That's great news, thanks! Is there any way to test it now, just to be sure? I'd rather not wait until tomorrow morning to find out it's still not working.

messages.label: check_device_logs
resend_timer_rules
Agent
messages.text: The timer rules have been resent. Your smart curtains should now respond to the morning open schedule immediately.

messages.label: User
messages.text: Ah, okay. So what do I need to do to test it?

messages.label: Agent
messages.text: Please set a test timer for a time within the next 5 minutes using the app, then observe if the curtains open automatically. This will confirm the timer functionality is working.

messages.label: create_test_task
User
messages.text: Okay, I've set up the test. What happens now?

messages.label: Agent
messages.text: Please wait a few minutes and observe if the curtains open automatically. If they do not, let me know immediately so I can investigate further.

messages.label: verify_curtain_movement
User
messages.text: Hey, it worked! The curtains just opened.
